subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: What status-output contract should OpenClaw support for chat `/status` and `session_status`: whole-card suppression, per-agent section visibility, or no new customization?
rationale: The choice determines whether an explicit command may return no visible reply, whether structured details remain visible to agents, and how provider usage or billing metadata is isolated in multi-agent deployments.

options.title: Per-agent section policy
options.body: Add a shared allowlist or section-visibility policy applied before both rendered text and structured tool details, preserving current output by default.

options.title: Whole-card boolean
options.body: Add the requested boolean and define whether disabled commands return no reply, a minimal acknowledgement, or structured output.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Reject new configuration and retain `/status` and `session_status` as explicitly requested diagnostic-card surfaces.

recommendation.title: Per-agent section policy
recommendation.body: Add a shared allowlist or section-visibility policy applied before both rendered text and structured tool details, preserving current output by default.
